title: Pullback and exponent coherence of normalized finite Tate comparisons
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and n>=0, with A=O_E/varpi_E^(n+1) and its universe lift [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the specified pro-etale and etale Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], and the pure root generators and normalization predicates [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. Suppose a family b of isomorphisms nu_T^* B_(r,T)(k) ≅ P_T(k) is given for every scheme T on which l is invertible, every annihilating r, and every k>=0, and every b is root-normalized on arbitrary pro-etale tests. Then every scheme map v:T′→T between such schemes has etale and pro-etale pullback isomorphisms c,d, normalized by IsFiniteTateEtalePullback and IsFiniteTateProPullback, such that v_pro^*b_T followed by d equals the canonical comparison/pullback interchange followed by nu_T′^*c followed by b_T′. For r<=r′ there exists an etale transition t:B_(r′,T)(k)≅B_(r,T)(k), normalized by the root power z↦z^(l^(r′-r)), with nu_T^*t followed by b_r equal to b_r′. No uniqueness is asserted here.

proof.text: Take c from finiteEtaleTwistPullbackData. Its root inclusion law identifies its root adjunct with pullback of units. Injectivity of the root inclusion gives the root equality required by normalization. The degree-zero formula follows from the constant-sheaf unit of the monoidal adjunction, the degree-one formula is the recorded generator law, and two-step induction gives all nonnegative powers using the tensor generator and monoidal adjunction identities.

For the given normalized comparisons b_T and b_Tprime define d as v_pro^*(b_T inverse), followed by the canonical comparison/pullback interchange, followed by nu_Tprime^*c and b_Tprime. All factors are isomorphisms. Apply the transported pullback normalization lemma to c. The required square is cancellation of v_pro^*b_T with its inverse.

For r <= rprime take the root power map q and the signed twist transition t from finiteEtaleTwistPullbackData. The exponent quotient l^(rprime+1)/l^(r+1) is l^(rprime-r). The root inclusion law and its injectivity prove the degree-one root formula; the constant transition is the identity, and induction using tensor naturality proves normalization in every nonnegative degree.

The limit cone equation at adjacent indices and the root transition inclusion law give pi_r(x)=pi_(r+1)(x)^l as underlying units. Induction gives pi_r(x)=pi_rprime(x)^(l^(rprime-r)). To compare nu^*t followed by b_r with b_rprime, apply local lifted root tensor extensionality at level rprime. Naturality of the comparison unit and of restriction moves t onto an etale generator. Its normalized root formula, the root tower identity, and the two given normalization equations identify both values with the same pro-etale generator.

theorem finite_tate_normalized_coherence
    (b : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
      ∀ (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k)
    (hb : (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
      (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      IsFiniteTateSiteComparison l E n T r hA k (b T hT r hA k))) :
    (∀ (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (v : T' ⟶ T)
      (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (hT' : IsUnit (l : Γ(T', ⊤)))
      (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      ∃ (c : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).obj
          (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅
            finiteEtaleTateTwist T' (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k)
        (d : (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).obj
          (finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T' k),
      IsFiniteTateEtalePullback l E n T v r hA k c ∧
      IsFiniteTateProPullback l E n T v k d ∧
      (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).mapIso
          (b T hT r hA k) ≪≫ d =
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).app
            (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≪≫
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T').mapIso c ≪≫ b T' hT' r hA k) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r r' : ℕ) (_h : r ≤ r')
      (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
      (hA' : ((l ^ (r' + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      ∃ t : finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r' + 1)) _ hA' k ≅
          finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k,
        IsFiniteTateEtaleTransition l E n T r r' hA hA' k t ∧
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).mapIso t ≪≫ b T hT r hA k =
            b T hT r' hA' k)
